title: DNOW Investors Have Opportunity to Lead DNOW Inc. Securities Fraud Lawsuit with SBS Law
author: Schall, Brown & Schwartz Llp
description: Schall, Brown & Schwartz LLP announced a class action lawsuit against DNOW Inc. for alleged violations of securities laws. The firm claims DNOW made false and misleading statements regarding challenges in its merger with MRC Global Inc., specifically problems implementing a new enterprise resources planning system. Shareholders who purchased shares during the class period are encouraged to participate, with an October 2, 2026 deadline.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company is accused of making false and misleading statements to investors regarding merger integration challenges, resulting in investor losses and triggering a securities class action lawsuit.

title: ROSEN, TOP RANKED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages DNOW Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action First Filed by the Firm – DNOW
author: Rosen Law Firm
description: Rosen Law Firm has filed a class action lawsuit against DNOW Inc. on behalf of shareholders, alleging that defendants made false and misleading statements regarding the challenges of DNOW's merger with MRC Global Inc., specifically related to material issues with MRC Global's enterprise resource planning system. Investors who held DNOW common stock as of August 5, 2025 may be eligible for compensation. The deadline to serve as lead plaintiff is October 2, 2026.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company is the subject of a class action lawsuit alleging material misstatements and omissions regarding merger challenges and business operations, indicating potential securities fraud and investor harm.

title: DNOW Investor News: If You Have Suffered Losses in DNOW Inc. (NYSE: DNOW), You Are Encouraged to Contact The Rosen Law Firm About Your Rights
author: The Rosen Law Firm
description: The Rosen Law Firm is investigating potential securities claims against DNOW Inc. after the company reported disappointing fourth-quarter 2025 financial results that missed Wall Street expectations, causing the stock to plummet 19.1% on February 20, 2026. Investors who suffered losses are encouraged to join a prospective class action lawsuit.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company reported disappointing fourth-quarter 2025 financial results with significant losses that missed Wall Street expectations, triggering a 19.1% stock price decline and prompting a securities investigation for allegedly issuing materially misleading business information.
